SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is a river? (1 mark)
   A. A flat plain
   B. Water flowing along a channel from high land to low land
   C. A steep hill
   D. A big lake

2. Why must children not do hard or dangerous work? (1 mark)
   A. It makes them stronger
   B. It is fun
   C. It is a school rule
   D. It harms their health and schooling

3. Which activity builds peace in school? (1 mark)
   A. Cheating
   B. A fight
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. A peace poster competition

4. Which crop is grown mainly in sugarcane growing areas of Western Kenya? (1 mark)
   A. Tea
   B. Coffee
   C. Sugarcane
   D. Wheat

5. What is a community? (1 mark)
   A. A type of crop
   B. A school subject
   C. A kind of animal
   D. A group of people who live in the same area and share things

6. Which of these is a cardinal point? (1 mark)
   A. North-east
   B. West
   C. North-west
   D. South-west

7. Which of these tasks belongs to the county government? (1 mark)
   A. County roads
   B. Immigration
   C. Foreign affairs
   D. National defence

8. Which action shows good leadership? (1 mark)
   A. Giving only to friends
   B. Keeping all the food
   C. Hiding the food
   D. Sharing food aid equally and recording it

9. Which direction lies between north and west? (1 mark)
   A. South-east
   B. North-west
   C. South-west
   D. North-east

10. What is discrimination? (1 mark)
   A. Sharing
   B. Treating everyone equally
   C. Helping
   D. Treating some people unfairly because of who they are

11. Which is a traditional food eaten in many parts of Kenya? (1 mark)
   A. Sushi
   B. Pizza
   C. Hamburger
   D. Ugali

12. Which of these helps drivers to see pupils on the road? (1 mark)
   A. A black bag
   B. Reflective strips
   C. Dark clothes
   D. A hat that covers the eyes

13. In many parts of Kenya, when do the short rains usually come? (1 mark)
   A. June to July
   B. October to December
   C. January only
   D. March to May

14. What is culture? (1 mark)
   A. A kind of weather
   B. The way of life of a community
   C. A kind of animal
   D. A type of road

15. Which of these is a problem of the rainy season? (1 mark)
   A. Shortage of rain
   B. Flooding and muddy roads
   C. Very dry grass
   D. Thick dust

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Give three reasons why people need directions in everyday life. (3 marks)

17. Give four instructions to guide a visitor from the school gate to the office using cardinal points. The office is 50 steps north and then 20 steps east of the gate. (4 marks)

18. Give three reasons why economic activities are important. (3 marks)

19. State three qualities of a good citizen in school and give an example for each. (3 marks)

20. Explain what harambee is and give one example of what it can be used for. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Water flowing along a channel from high land to low land
   Rivers flow along channels towards a lake or an ocean.

2. D — It harms their health and schooling
   Child labour is harmful and against the law.

3. D — A peace poster competition
   Competitions on peace teach and encourage it.

4. C — Sugarcane
   Sugarcane is grown in parts of Western Kenya.

5. D — A group of people who live in the same area and share things
   People in a community share a market, a school or customs.

6. B — West
   Only north, east, south and west are cardinal points. The others are in-between points.

7. A — County roads
   County roads belong to the county.

8. D — Sharing food aid equally and recording it
   Fairness and honesty are good leadership.

9. B — North-west
   North-west is between north and west.

10. D — Treating some people unfairly because of who they are
   Discrimination is unfair treatment.

11. D — Ugali
   Ugali is widely eaten in Kenya.

12. B — Reflective strips
   Reflective strips shine in light.

13. B — October to December
   The short rains usually come between October and December.

14. B — The way of life of a community
   Culture is the way of life passed on from generation to generation.

15. B — Flooding and muddy roads
   Heavy rain can flood rivers and make roads muddy.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: To find places, to travel safely, and to explain to others where something is. Accept sailors, pilots and farmers using direction.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sensible reason.

17. (4 marks)
   Answer: Start at the gate. Walk 50 steps north. Turn to face east. Walk 20 steps east to the office.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each clear instruction with the right direction.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: They provide food, they give jobs and income, and they earn taxes for county services.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct reason.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: Honesty: returning lost items. Respect: greeting teachers. Responsibility: doing class duties.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each quality with example.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: Harambee is people pulling together to solve a problem, for example to build a school or a clinic.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for example.
